terms.comment: A rule of canon law, not an ancient saying: the rules of law in Boniface VIII’s Liber Sextus include Quī tacet cōnsentīre vidētur (rule 43, as reference works give it; we have not read it in an edition).

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, cited by printed page; each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
